definitions.explanation: a line that is neither horizontal nor vertical; a slanted line
a line drawn through text to indicate deletion or cancellation

examples.japanese: {図形|ずけい}に{斜線|しゃせん}を{入|い}れて{面積|めんせき}を{示|しめ}す。
examples.english: To show the area by adding diagonal lines to the figure.

examples.japanese: {雨|あめ}が{斜線|しゃせん}のように{降|ふ}っている。
examples.english: The rain is falling at an angle like diagonal lines.

examples.japanese: {間違|まちが}った{部分|ぶぶん}に{斜線|しゃせん}を{引|ひ}いてください。
examples.english: Please draw a line through the incorrect parts.

examples.japanese: {不要|ふよう}な{欄|らん}には{斜線|しゃせん}を{入|い}れる。
examples.english: Draw a slash through unnecessary fields.

examples.japanese: {申込書|もうしこみしょ}の{該当|がいとう}しない{項目|こうもく}には{斜線|しゃせん}を{引|ひ}いてください。
examples.english: Please draw a slash through items that do not apply on the application form.

notes:
{斜線|しゃせん} refers to a diagonal or slanted line, and also to a line drawn through text to indicate deletion.

FORMS:
{斜|しゃ} (slanted) + {線|せん} (line)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {斜線|しゃせん}を{引|ひ}く: to draw a diagonal line / to cross out
- {斜線|しゃせん}を{入|い}れる: to add a slash mark
- {斜線|しゃせん}{部分|ぶぶん}: hatched area (in diagrams)

PRACTICAL USAGE:
On Japanese forms ({申込書|もうしこみしょ}, {届出|とどけで}), fields that don't apply are filled with a diagonal slash rather than left blank. This prevents unauthorized additions.

RELATED WORDS:
- {直線|ちょくせん}: straight line
- {曲線|きょくせん}: curved line
- {対角線|たいかくせん}: diagonal of a shape
- {水平線|すいへいせん}: horizontal line
